query.title: Query scene
query.body: Which earlier scene holds the person named in the pilot's message to the lantern keeper?

scenes.title: Harbor log
scenes.body: The harbor log lay open on the chart table.

scenes.title: Gulls
scenes.body: Gulls circled the drying nets while the tide slipped out past the breakwater.

scenes.title: Clay jars
scenes.body: Tavi folded the sail canvas and stacked the clay jars beside the stove.

scenes.title: Margin
scenes.body: The pilot wrote a question in the margin: Which earlier scene holds the person named in the pilot's message to the lantern keeper? Nobody answered it that night.

scenes.title: Harbor board
scenes.body: A copy of the pilot's message to the lantern keeper was nailed to the harbor board, but the name in it had been smudged.

scenes.title: Ink
scenes.body: The lantern keeper asked again which person the pilot's message named; the ink had run and the clerk could not read it.
